## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das spricht mich an** — [das shpriHt miH an] — *That appeals to me / That resonates with me*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei dir** — [iH bin gants by deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree*
3. **Es liegt mir am Herzen** — [es leekt meer am HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart / It matters deeply to me*
